outcome: The current session window is not yet read. Recovery reruns the unrecorded read, then replays any recorded admission and outcomes on the run's retained head.
The atomic shift admission has not committed: no seal or row binding is visible. Recovery admits the unchanged durable ingress and executes the turn once.

The atomic shift admission committed its seal, retained head and exact row bindings before its outcome was journaled. Recovery returns that recorded admission without widening its prefix and executes the turn once.
The plugin transition has not read the current head. Recovery reads it and publishes the initial plugin state on the run's recorded admission.
The initial plugin transition has not committed. Recovery publishes its plugin state without settling any ingress or running the tool, then executes the admitted input.
The initial plugin transition committed but its response was lost. Recovery adopts the published plugin revision without a second publication, then executes the admitted input.
The provider request is replayed from durable input with no committed model progress.
Partial provider stream state is process-local and discarded; the request is replayed.
The tool attempt has not crossed the external boundary; recovery executes it once.
The external effect completed inside the tool but no durable outcome was recorded; recovery MUST re-execute it under at-least-once semantics.
The controller call returned and its tool outcome is journaled, but runtime progress was lost; recovery replays the recorded outcome without repeating the external effect.
The tool outcome is journaled; active input and queued work stay open. Recovery replays the tool outcome and admits the unchanged checkpoint rows without repeating the external effect.
The checkpoint bound its rows to the run under its step; recovery reads the same rows back and replays the recorded tool outcome without repeating the external effect.
The tool outcome is journaled but no model continuation is recorded; recovery replays the tool outcome and issues the post-tool request without repeating the external effect.
Partial post-tool provider output is discarded. Recovery reuses the journaled tool outcome before replaying the request, without repeating the external effect.
The final checkpoint probe has not changed durable state; recovery replays the turn prefix.
Any final checkpoint admission stays bound to the run and reads back on recovery; the recorded provider and tool outcomes replay before terminal publication.

The final snapshot-bearing commit has not landed. Recovery replays the recorded admission, checkpoint and tool outcomes, then atomically publishes the terminal turn and settles its admitted rows under the shift fence.

The final snapshot-bearing commit landed but its response was lost. Recovery adopts its receipt and settled ingress without repeating the committed turn or external effect, then resolves the terminal gate promises.

The terminal turn and cancellation snapshot are committed but the base gate promise is unresolved. Recovery adopts the committed receipt and resolves the recorded winner without repeating the external effect.
The base gate promise resolved after terminal publication but its response was lost. Recovery adopts the committed receipt and immutable base resolution, then resolves the escalation promise.
Terminal publication and the base gate resolution are durable. Recovery resolves the escalation promise under the same committed winner without another head commit or external effect.
Both gate promises resolved after terminal publication. Recovery adopts the committed receipt and immutable resolutions without repeating the committed turn or external effect.

error_return.outcome: An unretried store error from start_run_attempt aborts the turn as a controller error (FIG-3528): the typed error reaches the caller and no tool body, provider request or durable commit follows.

A session-retirement refusal (SessionDeleted, with its cause) from start_run_attempt aborts the turn instead of recording a failed turn (FIG-3630): the retirement owns the turn, so no final head is committed, no tool body or provider request follows, and the typed refusal reaches the caller.
